description_en: Call `DsgUserGroupQueryList` to query user groups in Data Security Guard (DSG)

kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public dsg-user-group-query-list --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --name yun_group --owner user1 --project-name dev_project --user-group-type 1 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.description_en: The number of the page to return.

parameters.description_en: A keyword for the user group name. The service performs a fuzzy search to find matching user groups.
